description.value: A randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial examined whether d-cycloserine augmented cue-exposure-based extinction training effects on neural alcohol cue reactivity in recently detoxified alcohol-dependent patients.
Randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, parallel-group trial with fMRI before treatment and 3 weeks after treatment onset.

Craving for alcohol during the patient’s most recent drinking phase was measured using the Obsessive Compulsive Drinking Scale (OCDS (Mann and Ackermann 2000 )).
Clinical and questionnaire data were acquired 1 day before the first fMRI examination.

description.value: The German Obsessive Compulsive Drinking Scale was used to measure craving for alcohol during the patients' most recent drinking period, representing mean craving over approximately one week; it was also examined as a predictor of relapse risk.
